effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
payment_terms: Payment schedule to be agreed with the other party — add specifics in review.
purpose: I own a luxury pool and patio company and a local realtor team says they can send us high-end remodel clients. Need referral agreement with 7% on closed jobs they source, paid only after customer deposit clears, no commission on house accounts, no commission on pre-existing clients, and if a customer cancels or chargebacks hit in first 45 days that amount comes out of unpaid commissions. Need metro exclusivity only if they hit minimum lead volume, no poaching our staff, no bypassing us to clients, and a clean review then signature flow.
title: Agreement
